_README: Your read on players. This is gut feel and it is treated as gut feel: it multiplies the score, it does not pretend to be a price. Above 1 pushes a player up the list, below 1 pushes them down. Add and change freely, nothing else depends on it.

_scale.1.5: conviction buy, want every cheap copy
_scale.1.0: no opinion, default for everyone not listed

_alwaysAlert: Set true and every listing of that player is emailed once, whatever the tool thinks of the price, including PASS and cards it cannot value. Deliberately separate from conviction: conviction is how much you like a player, this is whether you want your phone to buzz. Leave it off for anyone you merely rate, or the email stops being a shortlist.
